basis: Only existing frozen original AB attributed rounds and all AB decisions; no consumer, no counterfactual, no new economics.
known_at: CP receipt must exist at signal close t and full known I ordinal computed only through t; never future first-CP backfill.
population: All registered rounds retained; financial_path_group mutually exclusive. actual initial buy is separate axis and can overlap UNKNOWN. Only original financially covered COMPLETE FULL rounds yield W/L/net/R/tails.
R: Original initial entry_risk; no 3000 budget proxy, no ADD risk synthesis.
months: Fixed all 2022-01..12 and 2024-09..12 for all four CP groups, even empty cells.

controls.rule: Require both compared CP groups have >=1 registered round on same date. For outcome difference additionally require >=1 covered complete on each side; missing economics remain excluded-but-counted cells, never zero-filled.

controls.unit: exact signal date x original sector industry ID
controls.rule: Require both groups coexist in exact cell. Same outcome rule. Do not relax to month/adjacent date/sector pooling after seeing sparsity.

controlled_metrics: Within each fixed unit compare group mean_net, W-rate, mean_full_return, mean_net_R, tail>=30 rate, tail>3R rate; equal-weight eligible units, first-minus-comparator. Show all coexisting and outcome-eligible n_cells/dates/industries/stocks, population shares, each side covered/unknown/no-buy, largest-day concentration.
selection_funnel: All original CP_FIRST_IN_I decisions, SELECTED_PENDING vs PASS_NOT_TOP2 separately. Join original queue_rank/selected_rank/PVR_score and exact date/industry all-group observed selected count and feasible candidate count. Unselected get no PnL. No shared-account or actual broker slot claims.
scope_limits: Descriptive selected-cohort association; matching handles date and observed industry only, not other selection/confounding, serial/cross-stock dependence, or missingness. No confidence interval or optimization.
